description: The pie chart presents matching statistics by showing the distribution of items across different numbers of matches, with a total of seven slices corresponding to match counts from 0 through 6. The slice for 6 matches is colored medium light blue and labeled 27.2% (8006); the slice for 5 matches is a lighter blue and labeled 10.4% (3043); the slice for 4 matches is very pale blue and labeled 6.2% (1810); the slice for 3 matches is light green-gray and labeled 6.8% (2002); the slice for 2 matches is pale green and labeled 22.4% (6583); the slice for 1 match is light yellow and labeled 13.8% (4046); and the slice for 0 matches is off-white/cream and labeled 13.3% (3910). Each wedge contains an internal text label showing both the percentage and the count in parentheses, while the category numbers (0–5) appear around the outside and the “6 Matches” text appears at the top near the 6-matches wedge; there is no separate legend and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice order around the circle does not appear strictly sorted by size.
